page.layout: One column of text on a single printed page; running head at top centre; page number top left.

main_text.l: σωρὸς loculus, conditorium: at σωρὸς acer-vus, masculinum est.
λέκιθος vitellus, ovi luteum: pro pisi specie commune est.

page.notes: Greek words are printed in a heavy Greek face with many accents; several readings (e.g. the dotted diacritics on σωρὸς, ναρδόναρδος) are approximate. Lines are a glossary list, one entry per line; the final word at the foot is a catchword "τείο-" set at the right.
